requirements.text: The video player starts in a paused state. Users can toggle between play and pause by clicking the video element (class='viewer') or the Play/Pause button (data-testid='toggle-play-button'). The button icon displays '►' when paused and '❚ ❚' when playing. Rapid clicks will stabilize the video in either playing or paused state, with the icon reflecting the final state. The video listens for 'click', 'play', and 'pause' events to toggle and update the button icon. The video plays when toggled from paused and pauses when toggled from playing.

The video player allows users to rewind or fast-forward using the Skip Backward (data-testid='skip-backward-button') and Skip Forward (data-testid='skip-forward-button') buttons. Clicking Skip Backward rewinds by 10 seconds, and Skip Forward fast-forwards by 25 seconds. The buttons use data-skip attributes to adjust currentTime, ensuring it doesn't exceed the video's duration or go below 0 seconds.

When the user interacts with the Volume slider (identified by the attribute data-testid='volume-slider'), the video's audio level should update to match the slider value. The slider allows values ranging from 0 (mute) to 1 (maximum volume) in increments of 0.05. The slider's value should be reflected in the video's 'volume' property, and the slider's UI element must be updated in real-time to reflect the current volume level. The slider is located within the '.player__controls' div and is identified by the 'player__slider' class and the 'data-testid' attribute. Any changes to the slider should trigger the 'handleRangeUpdate' function in the JavaScript code to update the video's volume property.

The Playback Rate slider (data-testid='playback-rate-slider') lets users adjust video speed from 0.5x to 2x in 0.05 steps. Changing the slider updates the video’s playback rate in real time via the handleRangeUpdate function. Values outside the range (e.g. 3) are rejected, and the video keeps playing at the last valid speed. The slider starts at 1x and is implemented as a range input with min 0.5, max 2, and default value 1.

The progress bar visually tracks the video’s playback progress by dynamically updating the width of the .progress__filled element based on the formula (video.currentTime / video.duration) * 100. It begins filling when playback starts (triggered via the data-testid='toggle-play-button'), reaches 100% upon video completion, and resets to 0% when the video restarts. Users can scrub manually by clicking or dragging on the .progress element, with real-time updates to both the video's currentTime and the progress bar's fill.

When the user clicks the Fullscreen button, the video player should toggle between fullscreen mode and normal mode. The Fullscreen button is identified by the attribute 'data-testid' with the value 'fullscreen-button'. The video player element is represented by the 'player' class in the DOM. When toggling to fullscreen mode, the 'fullPlayer' class should be added to the player element, and when toggling back to normal mode, the 'fullPlayer' class should be removed. The functionality should work regardless of the current state of the video player (fullscreen or normal mode).

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle play/pause by clicking the video
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Play/Pause Toggle
  The video player should toggle between play and pause states when the user interacts with the video or the Play/Pause button. The button icon should update accordingly.


  Scenario: [Normal] Toggle play/pause by clicking the video
    Given the video player page is loaded
    And the video is currently paused
    When the user clicks on the video with class "viewer"
    Then the video should start playing
    And the Play/Pause button with data-testid "toggle-play-button" should display the icon "❚ ❚"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle play/pause by clicking the Play/Pause button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Play/Pause Toggle
  The video player should toggle between play and pause states when the user interacts with the video or the Play/Pause button. The button icon should update accordingly.


  Scenario: [Normal] Toggle play/pause by clicking the Play/Pause button
    Given the video player page is loaded
    And the video is currently paused
    When the user clicks on the Play/Pause button with data-testid "toggle-play-button"
    Then the video should start playing
    And the Play/Pause button should display the icon "❚ ❚"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Rapidly clicking the Play/Pause button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Play/Pause Toggle
  The video player should toggle between play and pause states when the user interacts with the video or the Play/Pause button. The button icon should update accordingly.


  Scenario: [Edge] Rapidly clicking the Play/Pause button
    Given the video player page is loaded
    And the video is currently paused
    When the user rapidly clicks the Play/Pause button with data-testid "toggle-play-button" multiple times
    Then the video should eventually be in a consistent state of either playing or paused
    And the Play/Pause button should display the correct icon for the final state

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Rewind video by 10 seconds using the Skip Backward button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Skip Controls
  The user should be able to rewind or fast-forward the video by clicking the Skip Backward or Skip Forward buttons.


  Scenario: [Normal] Rewind video by 10 seconds using the Skip Backward button
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the video is playing with a current time of 30 seconds
    When the user clicks the Skip Backward button with data-testid "skip-backward-button"
    Then the video should rewind by 10 seconds
    And the video"s current time should be 20 seconds

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Fast-forward video by 25 seconds using the Skip Forward button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Skip Controls
  The user should be able to rewind or fast-forward the video by clicking the Skip Backward or Skip Forward buttons.


Scenario: [Normal] Fast-forward video by 25 seconds using the Skip Forward button
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the video is playing with a current time of 30 seconds
    When the user clicks the Skip Forward button with data-testid "skip-forward-button"
    Then the video’s current time should be 55 seconds

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Rewind video by 10 seconds when the current time is less than 10 seconds
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Skip Controls
  The user should be able to rewind or fast-forward the video by clicking the Skip Backward or Skip Forward buttons.


  Scenario: [Edge] Rewind video by 10 seconds when the current time is less than 10 seconds
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the video is playing with a current time of 5 seconds
    When the user clicks the Skip Backward button with data-testid "skip-backward-button"
    Then the video's current time should be 0 seconds
    And the video should not rewind beyond the start of the video

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Fast-forward video by 25 seconds when the remaining duration is less than 25 seconds
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Skip Controls
  The user should be able to rewind or fast-forward the video by clicking the Skip Backward or Skip Forward buttons.


Scenario: [Edge] Fast-forward video by 25 seconds when the remaining duration is less than 25 seconds
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the video is currently 5 seconds away from ending
    When the user clicks the Skip Forward button with data-testid "skip-forward-button"
    Then the video should advance to the end

reference_cases.title: [Error] Click Skip Backward button when the video is paused
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Skip Controls
  The user should be able to rewind or fast-forward the video by clicking the Skip Backward or Skip Forward buttons.


  Scenario: [Error] Click Skip Backward button when the video is paused
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the video is paused with a current time of 30 seconds
    When the user clicks the Skip Backward button with data-testid "skip-backward-button"
    Then the video should rewind by 10 seconds
    And the video's current time should be 20 seconds
    And the video should remain paused

reference_cases.title: [Error] Click Skip Forward button when the video is paused
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Video Skip Controls
  The user should be able to rewind or fast-forward the video by clicking the Skip Backward or Skip Forward buttons.


  Scenario: [Error] Click Skip Forward button when the video is paused
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the video is paused with a current time of 30 seconds
    When the user clicks the Skip Forward button with data-testid 'skip-forward-button'
    Then the video should fast-forward by 25 seconds
    And the video's current time should be 55 seconds
    And the video should remain paused

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Adjusting the volume slider to set the audio level to 0.5
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjusting the Volume Slider to Control Video Audio Level
  The user should be able to adjust the volume slider to control the video"s audio level, ranging from 0 (mute) to 1 (maximum volume).


Scenario: [Normal] Adjusting the volume slider to set the audio level to 0.5
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the volume slider with data-testid "volume-slider" is set to 1 (maximum volume)
    When the user moves the volume slider to 0.5
    Then the video's audio level should update to 0.5

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Adjusting the volume slider to mute the audio (0)
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjusting the Volume Slider to Control Video Audio Level
  The user should be able to adjust the volume slider to control the video"s audio level, ranging from 0 (mute) to 1 (maximum volume).


Scenario: [Edge] Adjusting the volume slider to mute the audio (0)
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the volume slider with data-testid "volume-slider" is set to 1 (maximum volume)
    When the user moves the volume slider to 0
    Then the video’s audio level should update to 0

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Adjusting the volume slider to maximum volume (1)
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjusting the Volume Slider to Control Video Audio Level
  The user should be able to adjust the volume slider to control the video"s audio level, ranging from 0 (mute) to 1 (maximum volume).


Scenario: [Edge] Adjusting the volume slider to maximum volume (1)
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the volume slider with data-testid "volume-slider" is set to 0.5
    When the user moves the volume slider to 1
    Then the video’s audio level should update to 1

reference_cases.title: [Error] Attempting to set the volume slider to an invalid value (e.g., -0.5)
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjusting the Volume Slider to Control Video Audio Level
  The user should be able to adjust the volume slider to control the video"s audio level, ranging from 0 (mute) to 1 (maximum volume).


Scenario: [Error] Attempting to set the volume slider to an invalid value (e.g., -0.5)
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the volume slider with data-testid "volume-slider" is set to 0.5
    When the user attempts to set the volume slider to -0.5
    Then the video’s audio level should remain unchanged

reference_cases.title: [Error] Attempting to set the volume slider to an invalid value (e.g., 1.5)
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjusting the Volume Slider to Control Video Audio Level
  The user should be able to adjust the volume slider to control the video"s audio level, ranging from 0 (mute) to 1 (maximum volume).


Scenario: [Error] Attempting to set the volume slider to an invalid value (e.g., 1.5)
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the volume slider with data-testid "volume-slider" is set to 0.5
    When the user attempts to set the volume slider to 1.5
    Then the video’s audio level should remain unchanged

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Adjust playback rate to 1.5x
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjust Playback Rate Slider
  The user should be able to adjust the playback rate of the video using the Playback Rate slider, with values ranging from 0.5x to 2x.


  Scenario: [Normal] Adjust playback rate to 1.5x
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the Playback Rate slider with data-testid "playback-rate-slider" is set to its default value of "1"
    When the user moves the Playback Rate slider to "1.5"
    Then the video's playback speed should update to "1.5x"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Adjust playback rate to the maximum value (2x)
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjust Playback Rate Slider
  The user should be able to adjust the playback rate of the video using the Playback Rate slider, with values ranging from 0.5x to 2x.


Scenario: [Edge] Adjust playback rate to the maximum value (2x)
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the Playback Rate slider with data-testid "playback-rate-slider" is set to its default value of "1"
    When the user moves the Playback Rate slider to "2"
    Then the video"s playback speed should update to "2x"

reference_cases.title: [Error] Adjust playback rate to an invalid value (e.g., 3)
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Adjust Playback Rate Slider
  The user should be able to adjust the playback rate of the video using the Playback Rate slider, with values ranging from 0.5x to 2x.


  Scenario: [Error] Adjust playback rate to an invalid value (e.g., 3)
    Given the webpage is loaded and the video player is visible
    And the Playback Rate slider with data-testid "playback-rate-slider" is set to its default value of "1"
    When the user attempts to move the Playback Rate slider to "3"
    Then the slider should not allow the value "3"
    And the video's playback speed should be at "2x"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Progress bar updates dynamically during video playback
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Progress Bar Updates Dynamically to Represent Current Playback Position

  The progress bar should visually represent the current playback position as a percentage of the video"s duration. The progress bar fill should update dynamically as the video plays.


  Scenario: [Normal] Progress bar updates dynamically during video playback
    Given the user is on the video player page
    And the video is loaded and ready to play
    When the user clicks the play button with data-testid "toggle-play-button"
    Then the video should start playing
    And the progress bar with class "progress__filled" should begin filling dynamically as the video plays

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Progress bar reaches 100% when the video ends
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Progress Bar Updates Dynamically to Represent Current Playback Position

  The progress bar should visually represent the current playback position as a percentage of the video"s duration. The progress bar fill should update dynamically as the video plays.


  Scenario: [Edge] Progress bar reaches 100% when the video ends
    Given the user is on the video player page
    And the video is loaded and ready to play
    When the user plays the video until it reaches the end
    Then the progress bar with class "progress__filled" should fill to 100% width

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Progress bar resets to 0% when the video is restarted
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Progress Bar Updates Dynamically to Represent Current Playback Position

  The progress bar should visually represent the current playback position as a percentage of the video"s duration. The progress bar fill should update dynamically as the video plays.


  Scenario: [Edge] Progress bar resets to 0% when the video is restarted
    Given the user is on the video player page
    And the video is loaded and ready to play
    When the user plays the video until it reaches the end
    And the user clicks the play button with data-testid "toggle-play-button" to restart the video
    Then the progress bar with class "progress__filled" should reset to 0% width

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle to fullscreen mode
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle fullscreen mode for the video player
  The user should be able to toggle the video player between fullscreen mode and normal mode by clicking the Fullscreen button.


  Scenario: [Normal] Toggle to fullscreen mode
    Given the video player is displayed on the webpage
    And the video player is in normal mode
    When the user clicks the Fullscreen button with data-testid "fullscreen-button"
    Then the video player should enter fullscreen mode
    And the "fullPlayer" class should be added to the player element

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle back to normal mode
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle fullscreen mode for the video player
  The user should be able to toggle the video player between fullscreen mode and normal mode by clicking the Fullscreen button.


Scenario: [Normal] Toggle back to normal mode
    Given the video player is displayed on the webpage
    And the user clicks the Fullscreen button with data-testid "fullscreen-button"
    And the video player is in fullscreen mode
    When the user clicks the Fullscreen button with data-testid "fullscreen-button"
    Then the video player should exit fullscreen mode
    And the "fullPlayer" class should be removed from the player element
